newsitem.title: TUNISIA: COKE BOTTLER TAKES TUNIS BOURSE INDEX DOWN.
newsitem.headline: COKE BOTTLER TAKES TUNIS BOURSE INDEX DOWN.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Wednesday closed down 0.33 percent in trade marked by a drop in coke bottler SFBT shares, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 603.03 from 605.07 on Tuesday.
Trading volume was unchanged from yesterday at 1.83 million dinars.
SFBT lost four dinars to 129.37 dinars and retail stores Monoprix eased 1.34 dinars to 43.22 dinars.
